recognition_trigger: When a task asks for consecutive values in unsorted input, use value membership rather than input-position adjacency.
corrected_rule: Deduplicate into a set and start a run at n only when n - 1 is absent, then advance while the next value exists.
why_failed: Scanning adjacent input positions does not identify consecutive values that can occur at unrelated positions in an unsorted collection.
application: Build a set, iterate through its values, expand only from values lacking a predecessor, count each run with a while loop, and retain the largest count in expected O(n) time and O(n) space.
